result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only genuine visual defect is a spelling error in the search placeholder ('Restarants'). Partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll affordances and were not counted as defects.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text contains a typo: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' should read 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder string to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' in the search input component.

issues.description: The placeholder text in the search field is light gray on a light gray background, giving low contrast for users with visual impairments.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color (e.g., to a mid-gray meeting WCAG contrast guidance) or increase the field background contrast so hint text is legible.
